prompt: Here's the claim-and-dispatch method our webhook poller runs on every tick. To push more throughput we scaled it out to several identical replicas, but combined delivery rate barely moved — two replicas together deliver at roughly the same rate as one. Walk me through why the replicas are effectively serializing instead of claiming work in parallel, then tell me how you'd change the query so that N replicas each claim a disjoint batch and scale out safely without ever double-claiming (and therefore double-delivering) the same row.
